main_text.p: nis notam in Epistola Catholica ob-seruavit{p}pJud. Apostolorum alius; sed omnia sine murmure perpessi, quæ vel ingenium humanum excogitare, vel crudelitas ipsa infligere potuit, tanquam oves ad macellum ducebantur; & pro persecutoribus suis orabant: Dominum scilicet, quorum se servos profitebantur imitati: {q}q Luc.23.Pater remitte eis, nesciunt enim quid faciunt. Dum adhuc in suis incunabulis vagiret Ecclesia, passim {r}r Act.17.7.infimulabantur Christiani se nescio quam sibi assumere libertatis Christianæ indulgentiam, & ordinationes politicas, vel ut diabolicas execrari, vel ut prophanas contemnere. Hinc ille in Epistolis Apo-stolorum insertæ sententiæ, (tanquam tot in caliginosa nocte scintillantes stel-lulæ, aut in pauimento emblemata vermiculata) de obedientia civili magistra-tui præstanda. Divus Paulus in Epistola ad Romanos, cap. 13. hunc in modum exorditur. Omnis anima potestatibus su-pereminentibus subiecta esto. Omnis, non Laicorum modo, sed omnis simpliciter: [sive sit Apostolus, sivè Evangelista, sivè Sacerdos, inquit Chrysostomus. ] Non

page.notes: Doubtful: the reference "pJud." is printed "pJud." and is kept as printed. The abbreviation "Act." is printed as a ligature (Aƈ) and is transcribed as "Act.". The phrase "subiectaesto" is printed without a clear space; it is transcribed as "subiecta esto" in italics. The word "siuè" is printed with a grave accent and is kept as "sivè". The long s, printed as f in places, is transcribed as plain s throughout.
